899 stacks of 10-12 shows covering the whole Fugazi repertoire (94 songs), one for each show in the Fugazi Live Series.

Source: R/data.R
gid_initial_gid_sound_quality.Rd

899 stacks of 10-12 shows covering the whole Fugazi repertoire (94 songs), one for each show in the Fugazi Live Series.

Usage

gid_initial_gid_sound_quality

Format

dataframe with one row for each combination of initial show and stacked show.

gid_initial

show id of the initial show, used to identify each stack of shows

gid

show id of each show contained within each stack

sound_quality

Sound quality rating: Excellent, Very Good, Good, or Poor.

Source

https://www.dischord.com/fugazi_live_series

Provenance

Derived, generated once (via sweepstack/stacks) and not regenerated by any current R/ pipeline stage or by data-raw/build_data.R - do not assume it reflects the latest duration_data_da. Actively consumed directly by inst/shiny/Fugazetteer/app.R for the "stock" pages, so despite being un-regenerated it is not orphaned; confirm via R/, vignettes/, and app.R before ever tagging it (or anything else) Frozen-legacy.

Examples

gid_initial_gid_sound_quality
#> # A tibble: 10,846 × 3
#>    gid_initial         gid                            sound_quality
#>    <chr>               <chr>                          <chr>        
#>  1 aalst-belgium-92390 aalst-belgium-92390            Good         
#>  2 aalst-belgium-92390 baltimore-md-usa-51298         Poor         
#>  3 aalst-belgium-92390 belfast-northern-ireland-50995 Good         
#>  4 aalst-belgium-92390 bryan-tx-usa-41193             Very Good    
#>  5 aalst-belgium-92390 colorado-springs-co-usa-40701  Excellent    
#>  6 aalst-belgium-92390 glasgow-scotland-102902        Very Good    
#>  7 aalst-belgium-92390 linz-austria-111088            Good         
#>  8 aalst-belgium-92390 london-england-110402          Very Good    
#>  9 aalst-belgium-92390 nijmegen-netherlands-110989    Very Good    
#> 10 aalst-belgium-92390 victoria-bc-canada-70601       Very Good    
#> # ℹ 10,836 more rows
